The Mazda Protegé family

3 generations and variants in the Index, 2001–2003. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 2001

    Mazda Protegé MP3

    A 2001 limited-edition Protegé sedan with Racing Beat suspension, 17-inch wheels and the first MP3-playing stereo ever installed at a factory, built in a run of just 1,500. Slow in a straight line and brilliant in the bends, it earned a place in a Road & Track handling test beside a Ferrari 360 Modena.

    140 hp8.2 sec 0-601,500 built
  2. 2002–2003

    Mazda Protegé5

    The 5-door wagon version of Mazda's early-2000s Protegé, with quick hydraulic steering, a crisp chassis and a shape that still looks right. Modest 130 hp aside, it was the car magazine editors wanted for themselves, and it remains a bargain-priced lesson in how much feel a small car can deliver.

    130 hp9.5 sec 0-60118 mph top
  3. 2003

    Mazdaspeed Protegé

    The turbocharged finale of the Protegé line: 170 hp from a Garrett turbo developed with Callaway, a limited-slip differential, bigger brakes and Racing Beat suspension. It answered everyone who said the MP3 needed more power, and it remains one of the rarest Mazda compacts of its era.

    170 hp6.9 sec 0-604,500 built
